solution.title: Enterprise App & Service Principal Governance (App Registrations, API Permissions)

products.name: Enterprise App & Service Principal Governance (App Registrations, API Permissions) — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to govern enterprise apps and service principals in Microsoft Entra — inventory them, review consent and API permissions for over-privilege, control user consent, and manage secret/certificate hygiene. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Find the risky OAuth apps and over-permissioned service principals hiding in your tenant

Every SaaS integration and internal app leaves behind an enterprise app, a service principal, and a set of API permissions — and over time they pile up: apps nobody owns, dangerous consented permissions, and app secrets/certs quietly expiring or lingering forever. Attackers love them. This solution gives you a repeatable way to govern enterprise apps and service principals in Microsoft Entra: inventory them, review consent and API permissions for over-privilege, control user consent, and manage secret/certificate hygiene.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Entra app model (app registrations vs. enterprise apps/service principals), delegated vs. application permissions and admin consent, the over-permission and consent-phishing risk, and secret/certificate lifecycle.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Entra ID, appropriate admin roles, a consent policy decision, an app inventory approach, a pilot scope) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory enterprise apps/service principals, review API permissions and consents for over-privilege, configure the user-consent policy (and admin-consent workflow), remediate risky grants, manage secret/cert expiry, validate, pilot, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — enterprise-app/service-principal + permission discovery, risky-consent and expiring-secret validation, an app-governance and over-permission report, safe remediation of risky grants, and a governance-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every enterprise app and service principal inventoried and governed — over-permissioned grants and risky consents remediated, user consent controlled, and app secrets/certs on a managed lifecycle — closing a favorite attacker foothold, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • APPGOV-Discovery.ps1 — inventory enterprise apps and service principals in Microsoft Entra
    • APPGOV-Remediation.ps1 — safely revoke risky delegated grants and app-role assignments
    • APPGOV-Report.ps1 — over-permission and expiring-secret report for enterprise apps
    • APPGOV-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build and preview the governance consent-scope and reviewer groups
    • APPGOV-Validation.ps1 — confirm the consent policy, admin-consent workflow, and remediation state

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
